hook: Which tech giant turned $1,000 into the most money?

sections.name: hook
sections.text: Which tech giant turned $1,000 into the most money?

sections.name: beat1
sections.text: It is 2015, and you put $1,000 into six tech giants.

sections.name: beat2
sections.text: Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Google, Meta, and Nvidia each get the same cash.

sections.name: beat3
sections.text: Amazon climbs to $17,304, and Apple hits $14,508.

sections.name: beat4
sections.text: Even the last place stock grows to $8,254.

sections.name: tension
sections.text: But one stock leaves all the others far behind.

sections.name: twist
sections.text: Did you guess it? Now ask again: which tech giant turned $1,000 into the most money?

sourceLabel: Source: Yahoo Finance, adjusted close, 2015 to Nov 2026. Not financial advice.
